aboutGame.title: What is Welding Simulator?
paragraphs: Welding Simulator is a Roblox welding shop game from Ice Panda Studios. Players take on metalworking jobs, switch between MIG, Stick, and TIG welding, and use the money they earn to improve their workshop.

The progression loop centers on cleaner welds and better equipment. Complete the 27 MIG jobs, work toward an A-grade result, collect welding helmets, and expand your shop across PC, mobile, and console.

modules.name: Welding Simulator Beginner Guide
modules.description: Follow the first-session loop: accept a welding job, prepare the metal, run practice beads, and finish your first paid weld.

highlights.detail: Prepare the joint and clean rust, paint, or oil before you start welding.
Run a few scrap beads to set your stance, grip, and travel rhythm.
Lock the work angle first, then adjust travel angle, speed, and distance.
Check the scorecard after every pass and fix one variable at a time.

modules.name: Welding Simulator Welding Techniques
modules.description: Compare MIG, Stick, and TIG welding, then use scored practice to choose the right process for each joint.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: MIG - Self-feeding wire makes this the easiest process for learning travel speed, angle, and gas coverage.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Stick - Practice striking and restarting the arc before using it on thicker structural joints.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: TIG - Two-handed torch and filler control reward clean metal and precise movement.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Practice - Run scored scrap passes before a paid job to calibrate heat and motion.

modules.name: Welding Simulator Money Making Guide
modules.description: Turn clean job results into steady income by managing consumables, practice stock, and contract difficulty.

highlights.detail: Take small flat-position jobs and finish them cleanly before bidding on larger builds.
Keep a consumables buffer and practice stock so one failed weld does not stall the shop.
Upgrade reliability before speed: better machines, cleaner cuts, and steadier work habits.
Spend earnings on one useful upgrade at a time and keep cash available for the next contract.

highlights.label: Machine

highlights.label: Cutting

highlights.label: Lighting
highlights.detail: Bright bench lighting makes bead shape and joint alignment easier to read.

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: Organized tools shorten setup time between welding jobs.

highlights.label: Space
highlights.detail: Workshop expansion unlocks larger multi-part builds such as go-karts.

highlights.label: Tables

highlights.label: Go-karts
highlights.detail: Larger builds such as go-karts demand tighter planning and a stable cash buffer.

highlights.label: Stock

highlights.label: Practice

modules.name: Welding Simulator Tips and Tricks
modules.description: Use focused practice, steady travel speed, clean joints, and replay review to raise every weld score.

highlights.label: One Fix
highlights.detail: Correct one scorecard variable at a time instead of chasing every error.

highlights.label: Tempo
highlights.detail: Count a steady cadence to keep travel speed consistent along the seam.

highlights.label: Clean
highlights.detail: Grind rust, paint, and oil from the joint before striking an arc.

highlights.label: Replay
highlights.detail: Review saved passes to compare a clean weld with a failed attempt.

highlights.label: Warmup
highlights.detail: Spend ten minutes on practice beads before each welding session.

highlights.label: Buffer
highlights.detail: Keep enough stock for two full jobs before buying another upgrade.

faq.title: Welding Simulator FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers about Welding Simulator gameplay, welding methods, grades, upgrades, and platforms.

items.question: What is Welding Simulator?
items.answer: Welding Simulator is a Roblox welding shop game from Ice Panda Studios. You complete metalworking jobs with MIG, Stick, and TIG equipment, earn money, and reinvest it in your workshop.

items.question: Which welding method should I learn first in Welding Simulator?
items.answer: Start with MIG in Welding Simulator. The wire feeds automatically, so you can focus on travel speed, work angle, and gas coverage before moving on to Stick and TIG.

items.question: How do I improve my weld grade in Welding Simulator?
items.answer: Fix one scored variable at a time in Welding Simulator: work angle first, then travel angle, travel speed, nozzle distance, and straightness.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Welding Simulator?
items.answer: In Welding Simulator, protect a consumables buffer and practice stock before buying cosmetic items, then improve machine capability, cutting tools, lighting, and workspace.

items.question: Does Welding Simulator support controllers and mobile?
items.answer: Welding Simulator is listed for PC, mobile, and console devices, and the Steam version lists Xbox controller support.

items.question: How many MIG jobs are in Welding Simulator?
items.answer: The Roblox version of Welding Simulator lists 27 MIG jobs, with an A-grade weld as a target result.
